gaps: when a key sits on the GeoOrigin its local vector is zero and both engines give the same odd point (lon 7.04, 88.5 km below the ellipsoid at the middle of 0 to 20 degrees): the case is kept because the two agree
the great-circle path pivoting on the GeoOrigin is X_ITE's own choice (a defect against any sane reading); the bridge copies it so the numbers agree
the interpolation is not linear in latitude, longitude and height, which a reader of the specification may expect
UTM keys are not tested here: the unit maths of the bridge covers UTM, the interpolator uses the same conversion
